findings.evidence: Theme cleared index TOCs regardless of repository or explicit setting.
findings.resolution: Repository-scoped TOC policy and explicit task sidebar in docs-theme#1747.
findings.verification: passed: theme tests and 200 current-builder browser combinations; publication receipt in certificate-management#119

findings.evidence: More than 550 code lines behind one workflow entry.
findings.resolution: Six task pages; expanded HCL and JSON remain together in Configuration.

findings.evidence: Repeated shared HCL and setup stopped at plan review.
findings.resolution: Link authoritative Terraform HCL, move downloads to Configure, show reviewed-plan apply.
findings.verification: source checks and executable Python variable-file test passed

findings.evidence: Source module requires ../http-origin-mtls; former download command omitted it.
findings.resolution: Download full module and Wingman naming contract before init.
findings.verification: passed: literal downloads, source equality, latest Terraform init-upgrade and validate; provider#2641

findings.evidence: No Maintain task; disposable destruction mixed into Verify.
findings.resolution: Add maintenance route and move cleanup to Remove; link infrastructure owner runbook.

findings.evidence: No Remove task or public JSON download.
findings.resolution: Add owner-aware removal guidance and equal public manifest download.

findings.evidence: References contain long source and old workflow-anchor links.
findings.resolution: Retain 15 reference pages, add JSON/HCL subdivisions, link current tasks, preserve narrow qualification claims.
findings.verification: all source links and canonical examples passed

findings.evidence: Certificate input prose was repeated under credential setup, with an empty Configure steps heading.
findings.resolution: Keep one input procedure, label credentials explicitly; certificate-management#133/#134.
findings.verification: passed: one prose copy and meaningful headings on current published builder

findings.evidence: TOC targets cleared the global header but were clipped by sticky breadcrumbs (heading y=87.84, breadcrumb bottom=111).
findings.resolution: Measure breadcrumb height only for Certificate Management; include the complete sticky stack in browser checks; docs-theme#1763/#1764.
findings.verification: passed: 200 current published-builder route/viewport/appearance combinations; representative screenshots reviewed individually

findings.evidence: Managed Certificate Management caller selected an old builder digest despite a latest default in the reusable workflow.
findings.resolution: Use :latest for the prerelease Certificate caller; resolve immutable run identity centrally; docs-control#2580/#2581.
findings.verification: passed: canonical selector regression and 209 CI checks; managed convergence receipt in certificate-management#119
